info.title: TonTuyau API
info.description: REST API of TonTuyau (docs/API_CONTRACT.md). Lists are cursor-paged; errors are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: A video id left out of the items and the total (the short being watched).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: As-you-type filter on the name (accents ignored).

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: A video id left out of the items and the total (the one being watched).

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: Videos only: published in the last today (24 h) | week | month (30 days) | year.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Videos only: short (< 4 min) | medium (4–20) | long (> 20).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What was typed so far, 1–100 characters.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: incremental | full | applyDeletions; every task when absent.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The previous page's nextCursor: the runs started before that one.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The last line's id: the lines after it. 0 (default): from the first.
